title: Loom evidence provenance v1
description: Provenance is an evidence label, not a quality ranking. Consumers must preserve it when aggregating or rendering results.

x-ui-rules.measured: Show only with identified physical measurement evidence and source.
x-ui-rules.simulated: Identify the simulation backend and version; do not call this measured.
x-ui-rules.estimated: Show model/assumptions; visually distinguish from measured and simulated results.
x-ui-rules.mocked: Prominently label MOCKED; never present as backend output or qualification.
x-ui-rules.unsupported: Do not show a numeric result; show the unsupported capability/reason.
x-ui-rules.blocked: Do not show a result; show the blocker and recovery action when available.
